ActorTalk: I still prefer live opera, but VR does have its perks. At least when I watch The Ring here, I don't get mistaken for a performer and dragged into signing autographs.
So did you sign them, "Dear Valkyrie"?
What made you think I'd waste time on that?
But... if you want my autograph, you don't need pen and paper. I can always "sign" somewhere else.
